finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: NEI L41 defines the pupil as the opening at the center of the iris, uniquely supporting slot 2. L38 identifies the lens, L39 the iris, and L43 the cornea as other eye structures, so all four options share the category of named eye parts while only the pupil matches the relation in the prompt.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Роговица — прозрачный купол, покрывающий переднюю часть глаза; она помогает фокусировать свет.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: NEI L43 describes the cornea as a clear dome covering the front of the eye that helps focus light.
